messages:
alex_k: quick heads-up — i spun up a stochastic-bridge build (bridge-12b q4 pc) on a tiny dedicated pool and ran the summarization + instruct suites. median token latency down ~28% but some quality regression on long-doc suites. notes below.

maria_s: can you paste the eval command + exact metrics? :thinking: 

alex_k: eval command i used:
```
./eval_runner --model=/runs/bridge-12b-q4 --dataset=rw-summ-1k --sampler=two-stage --early_fallback_threshold=0.30 --top_p=0.95 --seed=4242 --out=gs://rwd-ops/bridge-12b-q4/summary-output.jsonl
```

alex_k: quick numbers (baseline = float32 titan-run):
- median token latency: baseline 12.8ms -> q4 9.2ms
- throughput/GPU: +32%
- ROUGE-1: 42.3 -> 40.1
- BLEU: 24.7 -> 22.9
- ppl: 11.6 -> 13.9

rui_t: perf looks solid. did you enable spec fallback or was that a straight quant run?

alex_k: spec enabled. two-stage sampler w/ an opportunistic fast-pass (reduced-kv, fp16 shadow) and early_fallback_threshold=0.30 (if top-token probs differ >0.3 we rerun full-pass). i also ran with spec off:
- q4 no-spec ROUGE-1 40.6 (slightly better)
- median latency 10.1ms (slower than spec but faster than baseline)

sam_g: so speculation gives additional perf but may amplify distribution shift. do we have token-level divergence metrics?

alex_k: yes — token KL (fast vs full) median 0.12 nats, 90th pct 0.48. examples with KL>0.3 correlate with ROUGE drop.

jen_p: any prompt classes that fail more? long-context, code blocks, lists?

alex_k: mostly long-context summaries and prompts requiring exact lexical fidelity (code blobs, structured lists). short conversational answers are fine.

maria_s: enterprise legal summarization concerns me — we can't drop fidelity there.

alex_k: agreed. planned quick experiments: 1) raise threshold to 0.45; 2) lightweight post-filter to detect code-like outputs and force full-pass; 3) human eval (200 stratified examples: long, code, conv).

rui_t: for (1) also try adaptive threshold: threshold = clamp(0.2 + 0.01*(ctx_len/100), 0.2, 0.5) so longer contexts get higher tolerance.

alex_k: good call. i'll queue that. quick fuzz: disabling kv-prefetch on fast-pass reduced KL median to 0.07 but added ~6% latency vs current spec run.

sam_g: typical tradeoffs. human eval should be three arms: baseline float32, q4 no-spec, q4 spec. randomize & blind, N>=200 per arm.

jen_p: add a synthetic code-preserve holdout that tests exact-match preservation for code blocks (use code-preserve metric). watch punctuation/whitespace diffs.

alex_k: done. ci-bot posted artifacts: ci-bot: https://s3.redwood/bridge-12b-q4/ (logs + outputs)

maria_s: can we run embedding-distance (semantic drift) between baseline & q4 outputs? avg cosine might reveal content shifts vs token-level diffs.

alex_k: queued. prelim avg cosine 0.982; examples with large token divergence drop to ~0.94.

rui_t: rollout strategy: hold enterprise traffic. ramp to low-risk fleets (internal docs summarization) until adaptive threshold and code-guards are in place.

sam_g: timeline? how long for adaptive runs + human eval?

alex_k: each adaptive variant ~6h on pool. i'll run three: static 0.45, adaptive, kv-disabled fast-pass. human eval target Monday if annotations finish Friday.

jen_p: ping me when datasets are uploaded. i'll prepare labeling rubric.

alex_k: noted. also saw speculative path increase repetition on a recipes dataset — probably a beam+sampling interaction. i'll add a seed fix and re-run.

maria_s: keep seeds & experiment ids in the artifacts. :thumbsup:

alex_k: exp ids: bridge-q4-spec-v1, bridge-q4-spec-v2-adapt, bridge-q4-no-spec-v1

ci-bot: run summary uploaded: gs://rwd-ci/bridge-q4-summary-1739139300.json

rui_t: please add per-example KL + ctx_len to the CSV and flag top-20 worst regressions for manual review.

alex_k: will add. i'll update this thread when new runs finish.
